comment: "I found the sections on cognitive aids in crisis management most interesting. I also appreciated the practical strategies for implementing and customizing cognitive aids in the OR, including adapting them to local protocols and ensuring team-wide buy-in. The discussions on malignant hyperthermia and local anesthetic toxicity management were particularly engaging, as they combined theoretical knowledge with step-by-step crisis interventions."

"I found the detailed case studies and the integration of the latest clinical guidelines particularly engaging. The interactive diagnostic simulations provided a great way to test clinical reasoning in a risk-free environment.".

"I found the discussion on cognitive aids most interesting. Learning how symptom- versus diagnosis-based aids are used, and seeing how they improve performance in high-stress scenarios, was eye-opening. I also appreciated the practical examples from the operating room and emergency situations, which made it clear how these tools can directly impact patient safety. The emphasis on team communication and the strategies for implementing these aids in a real clinical setting were particularly engaging for me."

"I found the discussion on simulation studies most interesting, especially how consistently cognitive aids improved team performance. I also really appreciated learning the difference between symptom-based and diagnosis-based aids, since that’s directly relevant to real-world crisis management."

"The most interesting aspect of this course was learning how cognitive aids can effectively minimize human error and cognitive load during high-stress surgical crises. I also found the evidence-based strategies for improving team communication and the practical steps for implementing safety checklists in the operating room to be highly insightful."
"The course was well organized, informative, and practical. It effectively highlighted the importance of cognitive aids in improving patient safety and team performance during critical events."
"The practical examples and real-life case discussions were the most interesting. They helped me understand how to apply the knowledge in real work situations."
"The case studies were quite interesting due to the fact that it gives a realistic approach and response to the implementation of the cognitive aid."
